Kamala Harris campaigns for Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan Senate race

US Vice President Kamala Harris campaigned in Michigan to support Abdul El-Sayed's bid for the US Senate. Harris stated her visit was aimed at fostering Democratic unity. Meanwhile, a Republican Senate candidate in Michigan released a campaign ad calling for an end to the Iran war.
